verdicts.rationale: The coverage check found no API or web-service page, and HCAD offers its data only as raw text files to download and import (c4, c8) plus a search website.
verdicts.missing: No API documentation, endpoint or other programmatic way to query or change HCAD records is shown.

verdicts.rationale: Nothing in the pack mentions an MCP server for HCAD data.
verdicts.missing: No official MCP server, setup steps or announcement of one is shown.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no HCAD command-line tool, SDK, package or public code repository.
verdicts.missing: No vendor-maintained CLI or SDK on a package registry or public repository is shown.

verdicts.rationale: HCAD's source is a published public data set offered as files for import (c4, c8) that the district itself refreshes quarterly and nightly (c7, c11), with no records changing on a customer's behalf.
verdicts.missing: The pack does not state outright that users cannot change records; that is inferred from the data being public files and pages the district updates on its own schedule.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no API keys, tokens or other credentials, and because the coverage check found no API, the na case for an API that needs no credentials does not apply.
verdicts.missing: No credential model, scopes, roles or permissions are shown, and the pack does not say whether the downloads or search need any login.

verdicts.rationale: No OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL or other machine-readable API spec appears, and the coverage check found no API to describe.
verdicts.missing: No API specification, downloadable or in the docs, is shown; the codebook on the Public Data Help page covers the data files and its format is not shown.

verdicts.rationale: The documentation shown (the Public Data Help page and the property search help) includes no llms.txt file or Markdown versions of the docs.
verdicts.missing: No llms.txt file or Markdown documentation pages are shown.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no sandbox, test mode or developer environment, and the na case for a read-only API does not apply because the coverage check found no API.
verdicts.missing: No sandbox, test mode or developer environment is shown.

verdicts.rationale: HCAD publishes self-serve downloads of its county-wide property data as ASCII tab-delimited text files and GIS shapefiles for import into other applications (c4, c5, c6, c8), with import instructions and a codebook on its Public Data Help page.
verdicts.missing: The pack does not show whether downloads need registration or a fee, and the tab-delimited format comes from the pack's note on c5 rather than a quoted vendor line.

verdicts.rationale: HCAD offers its data files to users directly from public download pages (c4, c5), with only custom data requests going through a quoted estimate (c9), so nothing in the pack puts the main product behind a sales call.
verdicts.missing: The pack does not show the download or search steps themselves, and does not say whether any registration, account or fee applies.

verdicts.rationale: The coverage check found no fee schedule and no statement that downloads are free, and the only cost process shown is a quoted estimate for custom data requests (c9).
verdicts.missing: No published price, fee or free-access statement for the data downloads or the search website is shown.

verdicts.rationale: Property information is reachable only through HCAD's search website, whose address search matches literally (c12), or by importing the county-wide raw text downloads (c1, c2, c8), with no API or per-parcel data service shown.
verdicts.missing: The pack does not show size, year built or use among the fields, and shows no service that returns one parcel's attributes as structured data.

verdicts.rationale: The property download includes deed information (c1), so na does not apply, but the pack shows no sale prices (c2), no lease comps and no comparables query or filters.
verdicts.missing: No sale or lease comparables, transaction prices or filtered comp query are shown.

verdicts.rationale: HCAD's documented Real Property Data download includes owner name and mailing address in county-wide tab-delimited text files for import into other applications (c1, c4, c5, c8).
verdicts.missing: The pack shows no per-parcel query or API, only county-wide raw text files that must be imported first, and it does not show the codebook's field layout.

verdicts.rationale: HCAD offers documented county-wide bulk downloads of its property data and GIS shapefiles (c4, c5, c6), last updated November 8, 2026 (c3) with GIS refreshed quarterly (c7).
verdicts.missing: The county-wide scope comes from the pack's note on c5 rather than a vendor quote, no drawn-shape or radius query is shown, and the search website caps any search at 3001 records (c10).
